note: The hub. Real: every plinth is section 01's box at its own footprint and corner radius (layout.json); the rims' colors say what runs (teal), the two gold boxes (BNB yellow) and what has not run (idle gray). The starting grid's 316 columns are the sealed plans (heights by planned discharge, frame-data.json fleet.batteries), the dots on Texas the 270 mapped batteries; Parc Ferme's ring holds 316 ticks, one a sealed leaf; the Arcade's field and coins are arm C's 301 scenarios (game.results.C, game.histogram); the timing towers carry the Atlas and CMC reads (sponsors.atlas, sponsors.cmc); Team data's 18 tiles and their links are the Living Brain readback (brain_graph). Illustrative: the radar's sweep, the bays' heroes at hub scale, the pole lights. Design: the return road (the diagram draws no lane back to the grid), dashed and dim. Drawn idle here: the season purse and the launch tower; Flap's launch and OpenFour's graduation ran on BSC testnet on Nov 25 and are lit in the stack's finale. The agents' title names Agent Studio, which gives the six roles their identities and paid jobs; the one hosted agent, the evaluator, is drawn in the stack's finale.
